quizName: Hardest Questions in Kansas Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: How do reflective, brightly-colored helmets and clothing help motorcycle riders?

options.text: They should only be worn when riding at night.
They help other drivers see you better.
They do not make riding safer.

questions.correctAnswerText: They help other drivers see you better.
questions.explanation: Bright colors and reflective clothing make it easier for other drivers to see you on the road.

questions.question: What is the most important thing to consider when buying a motorcycle helmet?
questions.explanation: Protection is most important. Choose a helmet that fits well, fastens securely, and meets DOT safety standards.

questions.question: Before riding a borrowed motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Assume the controls are in the same places as your motorcycle.
Take it straight out on the highway.
Practice with it in a safe, controlled area first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Practice with it in a safe, controlled area first.
questions.explanation: Each motorcycle is different. Before riding a new motorcycle on the road, practice in a safe area to learn where all the controls are and how the bike handles.

questions.question: Why is improper braking dangerous on a motorcycle?

options.text: It is a major cause of motorcycle crashes.
It is not a concern because motorcycles have two brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is a major cause of motorcycle crashes.
questions.explanation: Improper braking causes many motorcycle crashes. Learning correct braking techniques is essential for safe riding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black symbols tell drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What should you wear to make it easier for other drivers to see you?
questions.explanation: Bright-colored clothing makes you easier to see, whether you are riding during the day or at night.

questions.question: Which material provides the best protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather and sturdy synthetic materials offer the best protection for motorcycle riders.

questions.question: What should you do if another vehicle is tailgating you?

options.text: Change lanes and let them pass

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes and let them pass
questions.explanation: The safest way to handle tailgaters is to change lanes and let them pass. Speeding up can make the situation more dangerous.

questions.question: What gives you the best chance of surviving a motorcycle crash?
questions.explanation: A helmet that meets DOT and state safety standards offers the best head and neck protection. Wearing a good-quality, properly fastened helmet is the single most important thing you can do to survive a crash.

questions.question: How should your helmet fit to provide the most protection?
questions.explanation: Your helmet should fit snugly all the way around, meet DOT and state standards, and have no damage to give you the best protection.

questions.question: When stopping at an intersection, use your mirrors to:

options.text: See if drivers behind you notice that you are stopping.
Look for dark clouds that may show bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: See if drivers behind you notice that you are stopping.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often to see vehicles coming from behind. Make sure drivers see you and respond to your stopping.

questions.question: Before every ride, you should:

options.text: Check that your brake lights work.
Check that the paint is not peeling.
Make sure your bike is completely clean.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check that your brake lights work.
questions.explanation: Do safety checks before every ride. Test each brake to make sure the brake lights turn on.

questions.question: How can you sober up after drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: Time is the only way to sober up. Your body needs time to remove the alcohol. Nothing else will speed this up.

questions.question: When riding, you should wear:
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors to be seen by other drivers, even during the day. Reflective materials also help.

questions.question: What footwear is best for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather boots offer the best protection when riding. They should be high and strong enough to cover and support your ankles.

questions.question: The best clothing for a motorcyclist:

options.text: Does not stand out to other drivers.

questions.explanation: Good riding clothes protect you in a crash, keep you comfortable, and make you visible to other drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs have white backgrounds with red and black markings. They show traffic laws for that area. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When nearing a blind intersection, you should:

options.text: Assume other drivers will give you the right-of-way.
Change your lane position to be more visible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change your lane position to be more visible.
questions.explanation: At a blind intersection, move to the lane position where other drivers can see you best.

questions.question: To reduce fatigue while riding, you should:
questions.explanation: Rest breaks reduce fatigue on long trips. Caffeine may make fatigue worse when it wears off. Wind and rain also increase fatigue, so dress warmly and use a windshield for long rides.

questions.question: When stopping your motorcycle with a passenger, you should:

options.text: Ride faster than you normally would.
Start slowing down earlier than you normally would.
Merge into smaller traffic gaps than you normally would.

questions.correctAnswerText: Start slowing down earlier than you normally would.
questions.explanation: A passenger adds weight to your motorcycle. The extra weight makes your bike respond more slowly to your actions. It takes longer to speed up, slow down, and turn. When carrying a passenger, reduce your speed, start slowing earlier, and look for larger gaps in traffic.

questions.question: When buying a motorcycle helmet, what should matter most?
questions.explanation: Protection is the most important thing to think about when choosing a motorcycle helmet.

questions.question: When riding, your boots or shoes should:
questions.explanation: Your footwear should be high and sturdy enough to cover and support your ankles. Heels should be low so they don't catch on surfaces. Shoelaces should be tucked in so they don't catch on the motorcycle.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Only wear a jacket at night.
Only wear a jacket if it is cold outside.

questions.explanation: Always wear a sturdy jacket with long sleeves when riding, even in warm weather.

questions.question: To avoid getting tired on a long trip, you should:
questions.explanation: Take frequent breaks to rest, even if you don't feel tired. Most experienced riders don't ride more than six hours per day. Wind, cold, and rain make you tired faster, so dress to protect yourself from the weather.

questions.question: The faster you drink alcohol:

options.text: The faster the alcohol is removed from your body.
The faster the alcohol accumulates in your body.
The less the alcohol affects your body.

questions.correctAnswerText: The faster the alcohol accumulates in your body.
questions.explanation: The faster you drink, the faster alcohol builds up in your body. Your body removes about one drink per hour. If you drink more than one drink in an hour, alcohol will still be in your body after one hour.
